title: phegopteris walkerae
intro: Phegopteris walkerae, commonly known as Walking Fern, is a species of fern native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phegopteris walkerae include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
